WORK.description: Mail about your job: a colleague, manager, client, supplier or recruiter writing to you or a small group you belong to, and the job's own paperwork, such as a quote, an invoice to or from your work, a contract or a work travel booking. Keep it.
do_not_mark: automated mail from a work system, such as a ticket update, build alert or calendar notice (AUTOMATED)
a company-wide announcement or newsletter sent to everyone (BULK)
a colleague writing about your life outside work (PERSONAL)
a receipt or booking for something you bought for yourself (ADMIN)

PERSONAL.description: Written by a person you know to you or a small group you belong to, about your life outside work: friends and family, plans, news, questions, replies. Keep it as correspondence.
do_not_mark: a colleague, client or recruiter writing about your job (WORK)
a person at a company or public body dealing with your own affairs, such as your bank, landlord or doctor's surgery (ADMIN)
a newsletter or campaign written in a person's name but sent to many people (BULK)
a post to a mailing list or group (BULK)

ADMIN.description: Your own affairs with organisations, outside work: receipts, orders, bookings, bank and card statements, contracts, and dealings with tax and government, health, school, housing, insurance and utilities, including a person at a company answering your query or complaint. Keep it as a record.
do_not_mark: routine automated mail about an account, such as a sign-in code, a shipping update or a reminder that a bill is ready (AUTOMATED)
a notice of new terms, a privacy policy or fees sent to all customers (AUTOMATED), unless it comes as part of a dealing of your own, such as a solicitor's at the start of your case
offers and newsletters from a company you deal with (BULK)
a quote, invoice or booking for your job (WORK)

AUTOMATED.description: Mail a system sends about your own account or activity: sign-in codes, password resets, security notices, shipping and delivery updates, reminders, confirmations of something you did that record no purchase or decision (a sign-up, a form, a submission), activity on things you're involved in (a reply to your comment, a review of your change), changes to a service you use or to its terms, privacy policy or fees, and notices from work systems. Useful for a while, rarely worth keeping.
do_not_mark: a record of a payment, order or booking, or a decision about your affairs, such as a tax assessment or an insurance claim outcome (ADMIN)
a release or discussion on a project you only watch (BULK)
the same campaign or newsletter sent to everyone (BULK)
a person writing to you, even through a service's contact form (PERSONAL, WORK or ADMIN)

BULK.description: The same message sent to many people: newsletters, marketing and offers, announcements, mailing lists or groups where members write to each other, and notices about projects you only watch, such as a new release. Usually safe to drop.
do_not_mark: a person writing to you or a small group you know (PERSONAL or WORK)
activity on something you're involved in, such as a reply to your comment (AUTOMATED)
a notice of new terms or a privacy policy from a service you use (AUTOMATED)
automated mail about your own account, even with an unsubscribe link (AUTOMATED)
a receipt or booking, even from a shop that also sends offers (ADMIN)
